release_highlights: One-radio frequency information with model-based Icom CI-V or Hamlib/rigctld configuration, AUTO COM/baud, startup auto-connect, connection test and direct connect/disconnect.
Compact main frequency display and opt-in RMKS1/RMKS2/Band auto-set on callsign RETURN; MODE is never changed.
Serial safety forces DTR/RTS off before opening CI-V/virtual ports and disables modem PTT lines for Hamlib.
Persistent one-client CI-V virtual COM relay using an already-installed com0com: COM8 prefers COM208 external / COM209 internal, then +100 on conflict.
Virtual COM devices are created/deleted only on explicit user action with UAC and persist across ordinary PSLog shutdown; normal connect/disconnect only controls relay handles.
Elevated setupc operations run from the setupc.exe directory so com0com INF files resolve correctly; user confirmed successful creation after FIX9.
Transient Windows file replacement locks are retried safely while external-change detection remains authoritative.
Existing contest log edits/QSL workbench saves preserve nonnumeric contest exchange values in RST fields while ordinary QSO validation remains strict.
